answer: Locks are entered in sonnet, expire in voyage, and karst lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 132 aliases as a result needs 34 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3087 identities would post 4850 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
